Client SBS model third-party notice

This non-root Moonlight 3D APK contains converted and optimized ZipDepth
TFLite depth models in:

  client-sbs-zipdepth-models.tar.xz

ZipDepth original base relative depth
-------------------------------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/fabiotosi92/ZipDepth
Pinned source commit: 91f3fd21e131641f51e8d35736d1958350180e3a
The upstream repository's source code is distributed under the MIT License. A
verbatim copy, including its copyright notice, is bundled beside this notice as
LICENSE-ZIPDEPTH-MIT.txt.

Moonlight 3D ships modified TFLite conversions of the original
zipdepth_base.pth checkpoint, SHA-256
a55910bb0b99c8c5e641cb9206e810b269690ad94e8a2ef08c827c4679391a65.
These are the standard convex-unfold-tail base model, not the separately trained
base_npu checkpoint. The static graphs retain the learned convex upsampling,
replace one unsupported grouped convolution with an exactly equivalent dense
convolution, store selected weights as FP16, and retain Float32 public tensors.
The learned global-context weighted sum is algebraically power-of-two scaled to
avoid FP16 subnormal flushing on Adreno GPUs without changing its CPU result.

Upstream documents the checkpoint as knowledge-distilled from Depth Anything V2
Large. The upstream repository does not provide a separate model-weight license
or an analysis of that training relationship; review and clear the complete
checkpoint redistribution chain before any commercial release.

LiteRT 2.2.0 native runtime and accelerator
-------------------------------------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT
Upstream release: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/releases/tag/v2.2.0
The non-root APK ships the official LiteRT 2.2.0 Android libLiteRt.so runtime
and libLiteRtClGlAccelerator.so OpenCL/OpenGL accelerator for its packaged ABI.
The source distribution records the official download URLs and SHA-256 values
for both supported ABIs. These binaries are redistributed under Apache-2.0;
LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt is bundled beside this notice.
